title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00123 — wellbore not published in this release

sections.text: Worked to change saver sub back to the right hand one
Performed pre-job meeting to p/u spear BHA
RIH w/ ITCO spear BHA
Engaged spear in tieback adapter fish, pulled w/ 6t overpull. POOH w/ fish to surface
R/b spear BHA, l/d tieback adapter stump
Performed TBT to p/u perforation guns
M/u and RIH w/ perforation BHA to 148m bottom shot depth

Closed UPR, opened choke. Confirmed line up. Filled string. Opened UPR, broke off TDS and dropped 1 3/8 ball in string. M/u TDS. Closed UPR and opened choke. Fired guns with 160 l/min 130 bar. Top shot at 145m, bottom shot at 148m. Continued to circulate w/ 160l/min
Circulated 1000 LPM 5 bar. Maximum gas reading 0,41
Stopped pumps and closed choke. Monitored well. Unable to circulate on TT due to contaminated OBM mixed with water. Emptied both tts and re-filled tts with clean SW.
Opened UPR and choke flowchecked well for 10 min, static.
POOH w/ perforation BHA from 148 m to 14 m.
Changed to 4 1/2" inserts in BX-ELEVATOR.
L/d perforation BHA.
Performed TBT for cutting 10 3/4" casing
Removed master bushing. Installed PS-21 slips.
P/u and m/u 10 3/4" cutter BHA.
RIH w/ 10 3/4" cutter BHA on 5 1/2" DP from surface to 312 m.
M/u TDS. Recorded up/down weight 76 71 ton. Filled DP. Initiated circulation 500 LPM 73 bar, 50 RPM 0 to 3 KNM.
Cut 10 3/4" casing at 312 m, 400 LPM, 50 RPM. SPP dropped, good indication of cut.
Lined up to TT and performed flowcheck, well static.
POOH w/ 10 3/4" cutter BHA on 5 1/2" DP from 312 m to 9,5 m.
L/d cutter BHA.
Cleaned and cleared drill floor.
Performed TBT for drops inspection prior to milling 10 3/4" casing hanger.
Performed drops inspection of TDS, and both prss.
M/u CH milling BHA
RIH w/ CH milling BHA on 5 1/2" DP from 72 m to 110 m. M/u TDS and continued RIH, tagged top of 10 3/4" CH at 139,9m. Pulled up and filled string.
Milled id in 10 3/4" CH to 12 1/4". 100 RPM 9-18 KNM, 2000 LPM 10,8 bar, 4-5 ton wob. Increased wob to 8 10 ton after milling first 20 cm.
Continued milling 10 3/4" CH, 100 RPM 10 16 KNM, 2000 LPM 11 bar, wob 8 10 ton. Stalled out several times
Tagged top of 10 3/4" casing 1 m below 10 3/4" CH. Dressed off approximately 5 cm of top of 10 3/4" casing, 120 RPM 5 10 KNM, 2000 LPM 10 bar.
Circulated 2 x b/u w/ 3000 LPM 22 bar. R/b 1 stand 5 1/2" DP.
Performed drops inspection of TDS. Meanwhile flowchecked well, static. Performed TBT for l/o milling BHA.
POOH w/ CH milling BHA on 5 1/2" DP from 110 m to 72 m.
R/b 8 1/4" DC. B/o and l/o CH milling BHA.
